Subject: MSA redlines + vendor registration questions for Coupa/Ariba

Hi Tessa / Marissa —

Thanks for moving quickly here. We're ready to onboard Redwood into our procurement portal (we use Coupa for POs, Ariba for catalog sync). Legal has a few redlines to our MSA and our procurement team needs a clear list of PO acceptance fields and EDI acknowledgements before we finish registration.

Attached is our vendor intake form and the current MSA redline that our legal team started. Can you confirm:
- Your preferred billing entity and remit-to address for PO mapping
- EDI ack window (how quickly do you typically ACK POs / EDI 850s)
- Any required PO header fields (cost center, project code, tax jurisdiction)

We'd also like to schedule a short call with Ops to walk the Coupa credentialing steps.

Attachments: MedSys_Vendor_Intake.pdf (pdf), MSA_Redlines_from_MedSys.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Sr. Procurement Manager
MedSys Health

Subject: Re: MSA redlines + vendor registration questions for Coupa/Ariba

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the quick context and the form. Next steps from our side:
1) Legal (cc Marissa) will review MedSys redlines and produce a counter-redline. Expect MSA_Redline_v2 from us by EOD tomorrow.
2) Ops (cc Mateo) will confirm PO/EDI mapping and credentialing checklist for Coupa. I'm attaching our standard Order Form Template and a short Coupa/Ariba field mapping checklist so you can see the required attributes.
3) I propose a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow at 11am PT to run through the onboarding checklist and any open legal items — does that work for you?

Quick answers inline:
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. — remit-to will be on the order form (we'll populate once MSA is agreed).
- EDI ACK window: ops prefers 48 hours for first/initial ACK, but can accept 24 hours for critical POs; Mateo will confirm automation options.
- Required PO header fields: PO number, ship-to, bill-to, tax jurisdiction, cost center (optional but recommended), buyer email.

Attachments: Order_Form_Template.xlsx (xlsx), Coupa_Field_Mapping.csv (csv)

If you can confirm call availability, I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partnerships (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redlines + vendor registration questions for Coupa/Ariba

Hi Alice / Tessa —

Thanks for sending the MedSys redlines. I've reviewed the vendor edits and prepared our counterpoints. High-level items we cannot accept as written:
- Indemnity carve (Section 10): propose a reciprocal cap tied to fees for direct damages.
- Data retention period: propose 90 days for logs, 365 days for customer data unless a regulated exception is verified.
- Audit scope: limit to scoped audit with 30 days' notice and a maximum of once-per-year unless a security incident occurs.

I've attached MSA_Redline_v2.docx with tracked changes and comments. Please review and flag anything you'd like prioritized for your legal counsel.

Separately, for the Order Form language please confirm whether you require a separate "consumer data" clause on the order form itself or if it's fine to reference the MSA. That will determine whether we need additional attachment language.

Attachment: MSA_Redline_v2.docx (docx)

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Legal — Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redlines + vendor registration questions for Coupa/Ariba

Hi all —

Coupa/Ariba onboarding ops notes and quick timeline:
- Credentialing: we'll need vendor admin email, D-U-N-S or tax ID, remit-to address, and primary billing contact.
- PO acceptance: we support automated EDI 997/855 acknowledgements. Default ACK SLA is 48 hours; if MedSys requires 24-hour ACK we can run a prioritized queue but may request a brief SLA amendment in the order form.
- PO fields: required header fields are PO number, buyer id, ship-to id, bill-to id, currency, tax jurisdiction; cost center and project code are supported as custom fields (we'll add mapping keys in the Coupa template).
- SFTP/EDI provisioning: provide SFTP host + contact or use Ariba gateway. We can provide SFTP credentials once vendor onboarding is approved.

I've uploaded our Portal_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf to the linked Drive and added comments on mapping expectations (see HubSpot link). Proposed activation timeline after legal signoff: 5 business days (credentialing + test POs).

Related link: https://redwood.app/hubspot/record/HS-4821

Attachment: Portal_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Director, Inference Operations
Redwood Inference
